'''''Aging and Tissue Regeneration in Kaminoan-cloned Troops''''' was an article written by [[Bur Veujarij]] for the [[Imperial Medical Review 1675]] around [[8 BBY/Legends|8 BBY]] that covered research and studies into the advanced aging of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
